_comment: Turn-event tracking: read DEALT_ARCANE_DAMAGE_THIS_TURN — private flag(s) nothing ever set, so the clause could never fire. The canonical keyword functions now record what happened this turn and EVENT_THIS_TURN reads it. Named the OPPONENT under 'target', which the handler does not read, so it fell back to the CONTROLLER. 'THEY discard a card' -- so the caster was discarding their own.
